description: This file is a shell script that runs a series of tests related to Git worktree operations, particularly focusing on the behavior of skip-worktree flags, index and working directory modifications, and sparse checkout scenarios.

methods.name: setup_absent
methods.description: Sets up the Git index and working directory to simulate an absent file scenario by removing and re-adding a file with skip-worktree flag.

methods.name: setup_dirty
methods.description: Sets up the Git index and working directory in a dirty state with modifications and skip-worktree flag set.

methods.name: test_dirty
methods.description: Checks that a file is staged as dirty with the expected mode and contents, confirming the dirty state setup.
